findings.claim: Removing `_properties as properties` from this public export barrel is a breaking API change for existing callers.
findings.rationale: `packages/zod/src/v4/classic/checks.ts` is a public surface re-exported as `z.<check>` (and/or `zod/v4/core` checks). Any consumer currently doing `import { properties } from "zod"` / `z.properties(...)` will now fail to compile or get `undefined` at runtime, and the type-only export disappears too. Unless `properties` was never released or is being intentionally removed in a major version with a changeset/migration note, this deletion should be a deprecation (keep the export, mark `@deprecated`) rather than an outright removal. I'm fairly confident this is a compatibility concern; the only thing I can't verify from the hunk alone is whether `properties` was ever part of a shipped release.

findings.claim: The corresponding `_properties` import (or its definition in the source module) may now be unused/dangling after this removal.
findings.rationale: If this block is an `export { ... }` list over names imported earlier in the file (rather than an `export { ... } from "..."` re-export), dropping the only reference to `_properties` leaves an unused import, which breaks builds under `noUnusedLocals`/lint rules. Conversely, if `_properties` still exists in the core checks module but is no longer surfaced anywhere, it becomes dead code.
